tasks.title: NinjaTrader as a signal SOURCE (not just an execution destination)

tasks.note: README.md's 'genuinely open' claim is STALE and should be corrected -- see docs/FEATURES.md and docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md. The module's own docstring is explicit that this is only PARTIALLY closed: the Python side (parse() and the FastAPI route) is real, tested code, but the C# NinjaScript side has never been compiled or run against a real or Sim101 NinjaTrader 8 install -- there is no NinjaTrader or Windows in this development environment to do so. Treat it as a reviewed reference implementation, not a verified one, until someone actually runs it in NinjaTrader Sim101.
